scope: Support-policy evidence pilot; SPEC-17 acceptance slice

cases.given: Two policy revisions have distinct revision-qualified source IDs.
cases.when: The compiler selects their evidence.
then: Each selected ID resolves to the supplied revision.
The rendered context retains selected identifiers.

cases.given: Two policies compete for a budget that holds one under the injected estimator.
cases.when: PriorityContextCompiler selects evidence.
then: Estimated source tokens fit the available budget.
The omitted source has a budget exclusion reason.

cases.given: A confidential policy has higher priority than a permitted policy.
cases.when: The caller compiles with INTERNAL clearance.
then: The confidential text is absent from model context.
The permitted policy fills the freed budget.

cases.given: Old evidence is compacted while recent evidence is preserved.
cases.when: The real compiler creates a summary.
then: The summary names every compacted parent.
Recent evidence and its identifier remain intact.

cases.given: Only the selected policy revision is citable for the answer.
cases.when: A real DAG emits a selected, superseded, excluded, or fabricated citation.
then: Only the selected revision passes the citation gate.
A rejected citation prevents downstream publication.

cases.given: An answer cites a source present in the selected evidence.
cases.when: CitationTracker records the claim without an independent support check.
then: The claim remains UNVERIFIED.
Source membership is not labeled factual verification.

cases.given: An instrumented LLM receives compiled policy messages and returns a fixed response.
cases.when: The run record is serialized and restored.
then: The exact message order and text survive.
The recorded output and token usage survive.

cases.given: A policy-answer agent runs through create_executor and RuntimeServices.
cases.when: The final RunRecord is restored and replayed in PATCH_ONLY mode.
then: The final state matches the original.
Replay makes no further model call.
The original evidence identity survives.

cases.given: The same evidence appears in two different prompt orders.
cases.when: Their rendered messages and fingerprints are compared.
then: Different rendered message orders produce different input fingerprints.

cases.given: A user has an explicit read grant for the item scope path.
cases.when: RBACMemoryStore.get loads that permitted policy.
then: The authorized item is returned without a global role.

cases.given: A user can list tenant A, but a tenant B grant fails its attribute condition.
cases.when: RBACMemoryStore lists project policies.
then: Only tenant A items are returned.
Tenant B content and identifiers are absent.

cases.given: Two runs overlap on one executor with one run logger.
cases.when: Both runs complete after a synchronization barrier.
then: Both runs succeed.
Two separate records contain their own output and run identity.

cases.given: A custom agent emits no optional token metadata but its LLM calls are instrumented.
cases.when: Recorded token usage exceeds the configured run budget.
then: The guard charges actual logged usage.
Further dispatch is blocked before another model call.

cases.given: Schema repair requires two model calls and the cumulative output allowance is five tokens.
cases.when: The first response consumes four tokens and requires repair.
then: The next allowance is at most one token.
Repair never resets the cumulative allowance.

cases.given: A protocol adapter returns retryable failed completion results.
cases.when: The foreground client executes its retry and circuit policies.
then: Attempt count respects the configured retry policy.
Failed results count toward opening the circuit.

cases.given: A manifest pins a policy revision, content digest, and exact excerpt.
cases.when: The backing bytes are modified, replaced, or missing.
then: Resolution fails before model dispatch.
The original snapshot remains independently verifiable.

cases.given: One model call includes messages, tools, model options, and compiler/policy versions.
cases.when: An independently loaded evidence manifest is inspected.
then: Every input field and ordered message is recoverable.
Changing input order, tool schema, model settings, source revision, or policy version changes the request identity.

cases.given: A complete request includes system/user messages, framing, tools, and an output reservation.
cases.when: The application computes the provider-specific input allowance before dispatch.
then: Actual input accounting includes the complete rendered request, not only raw source estimates.
Over-budget or zero-remaining-budget requests halt before the provider call.
Estimated and provider-reported token counts remain separately labeled.

cases.given: A policy is retrieved while authorized and access is revoked before dispatch or export.
cases.when: The application attempts to use or disclose the snapshot.
then: Authorization is rechecked at the declared boundary.
Denied bytes and identifiers do not reach the caller or model.
Historical evidence access follows current retention and authorization policy.

cases.given: Policy fixtures include superseded, expired, future-effective, and conflicting current revisions.
cases.when: The application answers an as-of-date question.
then: Only an authoritative effective revision supports an answer.
Unresolved conflict or missing current evidence yields an explicit abstention.

cases.given: The selected policy says thirty days and proposed claims say thirty days, ninety days, or contain an uncited extra assertion.
cases.when: Claims are checked against independently labeled supporting excerpts.
then: Supported and contradicted claims receive distinct verdicts.
Unsupported additional claims cannot be published as verified.
test_nodes: tests/acceptance/context_provenance/test_evidence_boundary.py::test_claim_verdict_and_real_publication_gate[Approved returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery.-supported]
tests/acceptance/context_provenance/test_evidence_boundary.py::test_claim_verdict_and_real_publication_gate[Approved returns are accepted within 90 days of delivery.-contradicted]

cases.given: Answers depend on different revisions and some evidence is used only through a summary.
cases.when: One source revision changes, expires, or is revoked.
then: Exactly the dependent answers are flagged, including transitive summary dependencies.
Unrelated answers and the historical record are unchanged.

cases.given: A reviewer can access public evidence but not restricted documents or secrets.
cases.when: The application exports an evidence record or telemetry.
then: The export contains only permitted evidence.
Redaction is recorded without leaking original secrets.
Redaction does not silently rewrite the historical evidence identity.

cases.given: A completed answer and immutable source references are committed.
cases.when: All original worker objects are discarded and the evidence is loaded in a fresh process.
then: The exact recorded context and source revisions can be reconstructed.
Missing artifacts fail explicitly.
No fresh model generation is presented as deterministic replay.

cases.given: Two explicitly versioned provider adapters use the same corpus, retrieval outputs, and evidence contract.
cases.when: The same labeled questions are executed through each provider.
then: Both emit the same evidence schema and preserve source identity.
Missing credentials are reported as not-run.
No equality of newly generated answer text is required.
cases.gap: The opt-in real-provider suite is implemented. Available credentials returned HTTP 401 (OpenAI) and 403 (Gemini) during preflight; no successful live portability evidence was collected.

cases.given: A frozen corpus and at least one hundred independently labeled questions cover ordinary and adversarial policy cases.
cases.when: Simple prompting, citation-enabled retrieval, and the CEMAF path are compared with the same model, corpus, retriever, output budget, and question order.
then: Record unsupported-claim rate, unauthorized evidence, affected-answer precision/recall, review time, token cost, and p50/p95 latency.
Use blinded counterbalanced reviewer assignments and publish paired results and uncertainty.
Zero unauthorized evidence in the tested cases and at least thirty percent lower median verification time than the citation baseline are initial go/no-go targets.
Do not graduate when required human timings or live results are absent.
cases.gap: The matched runner, blinded assignments, and evidence validator are implemented. Independent workload labels, actual costs, and human timings have not been collected.

cases.given: A retrieved policy contains instructions to ignore permissions or expose another tenant.
cases.when: That source is compiled and sent as evidence.
then: Source text cannot modify trusted authorization policy or grant tool capabilities.
An evidence record distinguishes source content from trusted instructions.
